newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche shares drop on rating worries.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche shares drop on rating worries.

text.p: Shares in Deutsche Bank AG, Germany's largest commercial bank, slipped 0.34 percent percent in pre-bourse trade on Thursday after Moody's Investors Service said it planned to review the bank's rating.
Deutsche shares traded down 25 pfennigs at 72.60 marks while the broader IBIS DAX index was up 0.26 percent at 2,670.04 points.
The rating service plans to review the ratings of both Deutsche Bank and its Morgan Grenfell & Co. Ltd unit.

Deutsche, one of the few banks in the world to carry triple-A ratings from both Moody's and its rival rating agency S & P, has been in the spotlight due to problems at its Morgan Grenfell Asset Management fund management arm.
